description.narrative: Reserve UGA 23-27 The UGA. Bilaterale landenportefeuille Oeganda 2023-2028, expertise project is a sector unspecified (99810) initiative in Uganda, funded by Enabel under governmental cooperation. The project, titled Reserve UGA 23-27, aims to integrate and consolidate previous interventions such as PNFP and ICB II in the health sector. The primary objective is to scale up the Result Based Financing (RBF) experience in the Rwenzori and Albertine regions towards a sustainable national RBF strategy, which could potentially be expanded to other parts of the country. The project's scope includes various sectors and organizations, such as the Ministry of Education and Sport, Ministry of Gender, Labour and Social Development, Ministry of Health, Ministry of Local Government, Ministry of Trade, Industry and Cooperatives, Ministry of Tourism, Wildlife and Antiquities, Private Sector Foundation of Uganda, Parent-Teachers’ Association, People living with Disabilities, and more. The project also involves organizations like Save the Children International, Uganda Business and Technical Examinations Board, Uganda National Bureau of Standards, United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization, among others. The project's focus is on promoting equality, non-discrimination, and inclusion of marginalized groups, as well as implementing monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) systems, menstrual hygiene management (MHM), and other key reforms of the national BTVET strategy. The project will be implemented in four districts in Western Uganda: Kasese, Fort Portal, Hoima, and Masindi.
